test_case.test_name: Intel PTAT -ct 1 continuous one-hour per-socket CPU stress with independent health supervision
test_case.purpose: Run the authorized PTAT CPU profile continuously for one hour and prove every in-scope socket sustains meaningful processor load without hang, unaccepted throttling, thermal/power excursion, hardware error or loss of manageability.
required_package: Authorized pinned Intel PTAT binary/package, license, checksum and supported CPU/platform/OS matrix
Release-specific help/documentation proving -ct 1 workload composition, socket/core scope and expected behavior
CPU topology, firmware/microcode, cooling and idle per-socket baseline
Project-approved per-socket utilization/frequency/power/temperature/throttle floors/ceilings, heartbeat cadence and RAS/MCE/kernel/SEL allowlist
Dedicated full-hour window, independent hard watchdog, BMC/OOB abort and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Verify PTAT identity/support and capture the release help for -ct 1. Record CPU/socket/core topology, firmware/microcode, idle clocks/power/temperature/throttle state and non-destructive RAS/MCE/kernel/SEL markers. Under the approved hard watchdog run exactly `./ptat -ct 1` for 3600 continuous seconds, retaining complete stdout/stderr/exit and sampling each socket's utilization, frequency, power, temperature, throttling and host heartbeat with synchronized BMC evidence. Stop at any approved limit, then capture bounded error deltas, cooldown and post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized -ct 1 profile remains continuously active for the full 3600 seconds, exercises every required socket above the approved utilization floor and completes successfully. The host remains responsive/manageable, per-socket frequency/power/temperature/throttle behavior stays within approved limits, no unaccepted RAS/MCE/kernel/SEL event appears, and post-stress health is intact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires artifact/profile identity, vendor-proven -ct 1 semantics, a gap-free 3600-second timeline, per-socket measurable load, successful PTAT output/exit, continuous heartbeat and every approved health/error rule satisfied. Help output, a zero exit, one busy socket or a shorter run cannot pass. Missing numeric limits is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Validate the licensed binary, supported CPU/platform and -ct 1 semantics before execution
Confirm cooling/power headroom, synchronized independent telemetry, OOB access and external hard watchdog
Abort on thermal/power/throttle/RAS/MCE limit, heartbeat loss, hang or watchdog failure
Preserve baseline/delta logs, allow cooldown and never clear evidence, reboot or auto-retry
expected_evidence: PTAT license/version/hash/support matrix and release help for -ct 1
CPU topology, firmware/microcode, cooling/power and idle per-socket baseline
Exact command plus gap-free 3600-second PTAT output/exit and watchdog timeline
RAS/MCE/kernel/SEL delta, cooldown/post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On health-limit breach, hang or watchdog loss, terminate PTAT through the approved supervisor when possible, preserve the partial timeline and use OOB only through the separately approved recovery procedure. Cool down and recheck socket/RAS health; do not automatically reboot or retry.
